channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: À espera do tarifaço: as consequências econômicas para Brasil e EUA - O Assunto #1756
item.description: The U.S. Trade Office held public hearings on proposed tariffs against Brazilian exports, featuring input from multinational corporations and pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who called for cancellation of the measure. Economist Daniel Sousa analyzed the economic consequences, emphasizing Brazil's role in global supply chains and the potential impact on U.S. inflation. A final decision is expected by July 15.

item.title: Tarifaço: Caiado diz que Flávio "conspirou" contra economia do Brasil
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of 'conspiring against Brazil's economy' for his role in discussions regarding the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, calling his actions unacceptable and ideologically driven. Caiado also criticized the Itamaraty for abandoning technical diplomacy in favor of ideological foreign policy, claiming it harmed diplomatic relations with the United States.

item.title: Tarifaço: Flávio Bolsonaro não trata de etanol e de desmatamento em audiência, alvos de crítica dos EUA
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) participated in a USTR public hearing on proposed tariffs against Brazilian goods, focusing his remarks on social media regulation, corruption, and defense of the PIX payment system. He omitted mention of deforestation, ethanol market access, and intellectual property — issues cited in the USTR’s Section 301 report as justification for a proposed 25% tariff. Bolsonaro criticized President Lula and the Supreme Court, arguing the timing is the 'worst possible' for such measures and urging delay until after Brazil’s 2026 elections.

item.title: Receita de GO com consignado mais que dobrou após lei sugerida em reunião com o Master
item.description: The Goiás state government's revenue from payroll-deductible credit increased by approximately 150% between 2023 and 2025 during the administration of Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for president. This growth followed the approval of a state executive-proposed law, resulting from a meeting with a director of Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio não atacou as tarifas. Palavras fazem sentido. Ele as defendeu
item.description: The text refutes the claim that Flávio Bolsonaro attacked U.S. tariffs on Brazil, stating instead that he defended a posture of tolerance and appeasement, avoiding any direct contestation of American measures. Flávio endorsed narratives minimizing corruption in Brazil, despite allies being investigated by the PF, and used his USTR appearance to protect his personal and political interests, not to defend the country. The author concludes that Flávio seeks a 'better moment' for tariffs — meaning he accepts their eventual application, as long as it doesn’t happen now — revealing a stance of submission to the U.S.

item.title: Dark Horse: filme sobre Bolsonaro recebe registro da Ancine
item.description: Distributor Europa Filmes has filed the Foreign Work Registration (ROE) request with Ancine for the controversial biopic 'Dark Horse', depicting Jair Bolsonaro's 2018 presidential campaign. The film, starring Jim Caviezel as Bolsonaro, has completed the first administrative step required for commercial exhibition in Brazilian cinemas. The distributor stated it will proceed with regulatory, commercial, and operational steps to set a release date, to be announced upon completion.

item.title: Lula paga recorde de emendas antes da eleição, mas prevê ampliar críticas na campanha
item.description: President Lula disbursed a record volume of parliamentary amendments shortly before the 2026 election, yielding to congressional pressure. Nevertheless, he intends to intensify criticism of the use of these funds during the campaign and include in his government program a proposal to revise the amendment model, aiming to reduce legislative influence over the budget.

item.title: Flávio diz que EUA derrubou “mentira petista” sobre intervenção no Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed the U.S. government debunked the Lula administration’s fears of U.S. military intervention in Brazil, accusing the Itamaraty of spreading 'petista' misinformation. He called it 'absurd' that Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira feared the designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups could justify U.S. military action, arguing it only threatens criminals. The U.S. State Department’s response, reported by Metrópoles, stated the U.S. is acting within its sovereign authority to combat narcoterrorist gangs operating in the U.S.

item.title: Paulo Vieira, amigo de Lula a Luciano Huck, resgata espaço do humor na Globo
item.description: The series Pablo & Luisão, created by Paulo Vieira and inspired by his childhood in Palmas (TO), returns to TV Globo in traditional comedy time slots, marking the network's return to humor on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Vieira, a friend of Luciano Huck and close to President Lula and Janja, also gained attention in 2026 for winning a lawsuit against Luciano Hang, a Bolsonaro supporter.

item.title: “Desmentido por instituição estrangeira séria”, diz Flávio sobre Lula
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that the U.S. Department of State denied the hypothesis raised by Itamaraty regarding a possible American military action after the U.S. classified CV and PCC as terrorist organizations. He described the foreign institution as 'serious,' implicitly contrasting it with the Lula government and suggesting the U.S. is correcting a mistaken Brazilian narrative.

item.title: A resposta dos EUA à avaliação do Itamaraty sobre risco de operações militares no Brasil
item.description: The United States dismissed as absurd the Itamaraty assessment that it might conduct military operations in Brazil after designating the Comando Vermelho and Primeiro Comando da Capital as terrorist organizations. The State Department said U.S. actions are based on sovereign prerogatives to combat narcoterrorists now operating in the U.S. The Itamaraty assessment appears in responses to information requests by federal deputies, signed by Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira.

item.title: Preso com fuzil, Canella deu aula de segurança pública em MBA em maio
item.description: Belford Roxo's former mayor and União Brasil Senate pré-candidate, Márcio Canella, was arrested after Federal Police found a rifle in his car during Operation Unha e Carne. Despite the arrest, he had been highlighted in May as a speaker at the launch of a Public Security MBA, where he was presented as a model in fighting organized crime. The PF alleges his group moved over R$ 7.6 billion in six years, using fuel companies for money laundering and involving public agents.

item.title: Falas de Flávio Bolsonaro podem enfraquecer argumento brasileiro contra o tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended a U.S. hearing to oppose proposed tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing the measure would politically benefit President Lula ahead of Brazil’s 2026 elections. According to VEJA columnist Diogo Schelp, while Bolsonaro aimed to counteract the political damage from his family’s association with the 'tariff barrage,' his remarks on the Supreme Court and anti-corruption efforts reinforced U.S. justifications for the trade investigation, weakening Brazil’s defense. Only his defense of the PIX payment system was seen as a substantively effective argument for Brazilian interests.

item.title: Caiado diz que aceita propor ampliação do crime de traição à pátria no Brasil em meio ao tarifaço
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) said he would support a bill to criminalize treason in the ordinary Penal Code, currently only applicable in wartime under the Military Penal Code. He made the statement during a sabatina by the nonpartisan group Derrubando Muros, after learning that treason is not a crime in the common Penal Code. Caiado also opposed Flávio Bolsonaro’s proposal to delay U.S. tariffs until after the election, stating he is against any postponement serving electoral interests.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz nos EUA que taxas beneficiariam Lula em reunião sobre tarifas
item.description: Senator and presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) urged the United States to delay imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing it would politically benefit President Lula. He stated that with presidential elections in October, imposing tariffs now would be inappropriate and could reward the current administration. Instead, he proposed targeted individual sanctions if the U.S. seeks to pressure Brazilian authorities.

item.title: PGR pede ao STF que valide decretos de Lula que elevaram o IOF
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to uphold President Lula’s decrees raising the IOF, stating the measures adhered to constitutional limits and were grounded in regulatory justifications, not merely fiscal ones. He argued Congress lacked authority to suspend the decrees, as the Executive did not overstep its tax regulatory power, and that fiscal motive alone does not constitute abuse of power.

item.title: Senado aprova projeto que endurece penas para violência sexual digital contra menores
item.description: The Senate symbolically approved a bill increasing penalties for digital sexual violence against minors, including offenses involving AI, deepfakes, fake profiles, and IP masking. The law raises penalties for luring minors under 14, classifies these crimes as heinous, establishes new preventive detention grounds, authorizes 'virtual rounds' by investigators without prior judicial approval, and mandates psychological care for victims funded by perpetrators. The bill now awaits President Lula's sanction.

item.title: O que é o Pix Pensão, projeto aprovado no Congresso que vai para sanção de Lula
item.description: The 'Pix Pension' bill, approved by Congress, establishes automatic monthly child support payments via Pix, deducting funds directly from the debtor's account without manual transfer, even without formal employment. Authored by federal deputy Tabata Amaral and reported by Senator Ana Paula Lobato, the measure aims to reduce bureaucracy, ensure judicial rulings are enforced, and protect thousands of families, especially children. It now awaits presidential sanction by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Nikolas nega ter ajudado Michelle em vídeo contra Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) denied having helped Michelle Bolsonaro produce the video in which she criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that neither he nor his team participated in the video’s conception, scripting, production, or editing. He pledged to resign if anyone proves his involvement, responding to claims made by GloboNews journalist Andreia Sadi.

item.title: Zema diz que Geraldo Rufino está entre os cotados para vice
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that Geraldo Rufino (Podemos) is among the candidates being considered for his vice-presidential ticket in the 2026 elections, with a decision expected within two weeks. Zema also advocated for a public spending reduction agenda, including privatizations, pension reform, and social program reviews, to lower interest rates and improve fiscal sustainability.

item.title: Em audiência nos EUA, Flávio Bolsonaro acusa governo Lula e pede suspensão de tarifas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended a public hearing in Washington to challenge the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, accusing the Lula administration of harming American companies and proposing economic concessions to suspend the measure.

item.title: PF apreende R$ 800 mil com alvo de operação que mira ex-prefeito e ex-chefe da Polícia do Rio
item.description: The Federal Police seized R$800,000 in cash during the sixth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, which investiges a suspected R$7.6 billion money laundering scheme involving former Belford Roxo mayor Márcio Canella (União Brasil) and former Rio de Janeiro police chief Marcus Amin. Canella, a Senate pre-candidate, was arrested in flagrante for illegal possession of a .556 caliber assault rifle and had his assets frozen by court order.

item.title: PP espera União Brasil decidir futuro de Canella após prisão
item.description: The PP will wait for União Brasil's position before commenting on Márcio Canella's Senate pre-candidacy following his arrest in Operation Unha e Carne for illegal firearm possession. Party leaders argue it is necessary to await the investigation's developments and hear from Canella himself before deciding whether to maintain the ticket, which also includes Douglas Ruas as gubernatorial candidate and depends on Flávio Bolsonaro's nomination for the second Senate seat.

item.title: Zema indica que escolha de Geraldo Rufino como vice está "encaminhada"
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for president, said the selection of Geraldo Rufino as his running mate is 'underway,' pending approval from Rufino's party, Podemos. Zema noted he has met Rufino multiple times, including during his tenure as governor of Minas Gerais, and described him as a clean-slate candidate. The formal announcement is expected between July 20 and August 5, during party conventions.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede que Mendonça seja o relator de investigação sobre ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) requested that Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça be appointed as the rapporteur for an investigation into alleged use of parliamentary amendments to finance the film 'Dark Horse', a biopic of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Currently, Justice Flávio Dino holds the rapporteurship, but the defense argues Mendonça is already handling related matters, including financing involving Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro. STF President Edson Fachin will decide on the request.

item.title: Chapa de Flávio no RJ é alvejada de novo pela PF e vira novo obstáculo em meio a série de crises
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's Rio de Janeiro ticket suffered a new setback with the arrest of Márcio Canella, his Senate running mate and ally, in a PF operation linked to money laundering. The situation increases pressure on the PL to define a replacement, as the vacancy is no longer decided by the party but depends on the União-PP federation, while allies urge caution in making a change.

item.title: Zema confirma empresário entre os cotados para vice
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) confirmed that businessman Ricardo Faria is among the names being evaluated to join his ticket as vice-presidential candidate in the 2026 elections. He stated that negotiations are underway with the national president of the Novo party and involve coordination with center-leaning parties. The information was shared in an interview published by O Antagonista.

item.title: EUA: Flávio Bolsonaro sugere sanções individuais em vez de tarifas; governo insiste em caminho institucional
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro urged the U.S. to impose individual sanctions rather than tariffs on Brazil during a public hearing, arguing that tariffs would unfairly benefit Lula’s campaign and harm his own. The Brazilian government, led by Development Minister Márcio Elias Rosa, maintains that the issue should be addressed through institutional and diplomatic channels, citing high-level talks with U.S. officials to avoid or reduce trade penalties.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate falas de Flávio nos EUA: 'Claro objetivo eleitoreiro'
item.description: The Lula government rebutted Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's testimony in the U.S. regarding the tariff hike, stating his participation had a clear electoral objective.

item.title: Tarcísio inicia ofensiva com partidos para organizar base em São Paulo e tentar vitória no 1º turno
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas is holding meetings with the Republicanos party to align his base in São Paulo, aiming to avoid internal noise in proportional slates and consolidate his leadership for a potential first-round victory in the 2026 elections. According to Datafolha, he leads with 46% of voting intentions (52% of valid votes), ahead of Fernando Haddad (PT) at 30%, and is positioning himself as the leading figure of the national right, despite not currently focusing on the presidential race.

item.title: Cúpula do PT vê erros da direita e fala em vitória de Lula no 1º turno
item.description: PT leaders claim Lula could win the 2026 election in the first round—an unprecedented feat—citing right-wing mistakes and government successes. They stress the need for grassroots mobilization in streets and social media to achieve this, contrasting Lula’s approach with Flávio Bolsonaro’s perceived 'deliverism' due to ties with Donald Trump. The strategy focuses on boosting government approval through economic deliverables and energizing the PT base to turn favorable sentiment into electoral victory.

item.title: Governo Lula acusa Flávio de “traição à Pátria” após audiência nos EUA
item.description: The Lula government accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) of 'treason against the Fatherland' for participating in a hearing at the U.S. Trade Representative's Office (USTR) to discuss tariffs on Brazilian products. The Presidency's Secretariat of Communication issued an official statement on Tuesday, the 8th, labeling the action as harmful to national interests. The government argues that the senator's initiative negatively interferes in Brazil-U.S. trade relations.

item.title: Lindbergh chama Flávio Bolsonaro de “lacaio de Trump”
item.description: Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) accused Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of being a "Trump lackey" after the senator urged the U.S. to suspend 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, claiming the measure harms the Brazilian people and benefits the Lula government. Lindbergh argued Flávio is merely trying to erase his past support for the tariffs and Trump, shifting his stance only for electoral convenience.

item.title: Senado aprova criação do 'Pix Pensão', que prevê transferência automática de pensão alimentícia. Entenda como vai funcionar
item.description: The Senate approved the 'Pix Pension' bill, which establishes an automatic transfer mechanism for child support payments via Brazil's instant payment system (Pix), mandatory for banks following court rulings. The system enables automatic debits from the payer's account and allows automatic freezing of financial assets if funds are insufficient, with the possibility of conversion to seizure if non-payment continues. The measure, already passed by the Chamber of Deputies, awaits presidential sanction and aims to reduce delays in child support payments, particularly for minors.

item.title: Zema diz que direita “perdeu” ao deixar Tarcísio em 2º plano
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for President from Novo, stated that São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) would be an "extremely viable" presidential candidate in 2026 and that the right "lost" by sidelining him. He said Bolsonaro encouraged him to run and argued that multiple right-wing candidates in the first round strengthen, not divide, the bloc, with expected unity in the runoff.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia falas de Flávio em audiência nos EUA: ‘claro objetivo eleitoreiro’
item.description: The Lula government criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a USTR hearing in the U.S., accusing him of having electoral motives by suggesting the postponement of a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian goods. The government stated that Flávio did not oppose the measure, omitted ties to Jair Bolsonaro's administration, and proposed subordinating Pix to U.S. interests, which it labeled as treason against the nation.

item.title: Nikolas diz que renuncia ao mandato se ‘provarem’ envolvimento em vídeo de Michelle contra Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) denied involvement in producing the video where Michelle Bolsonaro exposed her rift with Flávio Bolsonaro, pledging to resign if his participation is proven. He also rejected claims that he plans to leave the PL after helping elect a right-wing caucus, stating he remains in the party to build a legitimate and honest right-wing bloc. Despite tensions, Nikolas appeared alongside Flávio at a PL event and reiterated his respect for both, avoiding commentary to prevent amplifying the crisis within Bolsonarism.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia fala de Flávio em audiência nos EUA: "Traição à Pátria"
item.description: The Lula government condemned Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a USTR hearing in the U.S., calling his stance 'treason to the Fatherland' for suggesting a delay in the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, while nearly all other participants opposed the measure. The official statement noted he was the only Brazilian attendee not to oppose the taxation, accusing him of having a clear electoral motive by attacking Brazil's digital violence decrees and legitimizing what it calls an unjust investigation against national workers and businesses.

item.title: Zema defende que Tarcísio seria uma candidatura ‘viável’ ao Planalto e critica: 'Colocaram ele no segundo plano'
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) stated that Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) would have an 'extremely viable' presidential candidacy in 2026, criticizing that he was sidelined for family reasons, which allegedly weakened the right. Zema also said Bolsonaro encouraged him to run and argued that multiple right-wing candidates strengthen, rather than divide, the political field.

item.title: Crusoé: Nikolas critica Lula por deixar o Brasil de fora das negociações com EUA
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized the Lula government for excluding Brazil from tariff negotiations with the United States, stating the country 'was left out of the negotiation table'. He praised Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for participating in a public hearing at the U.S. Trade Representative's Office (USTR), implying the opposition is acting where the government has failed.

item.title: Governo Lula repudia participação de Flávio em audiência nos EUA: ‘Convocar uma potência estrangeira a pressionar o próprio país é traição à pátria’
item.description: The Lula government condemned Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s participation in a U.S. hearing on trade tariffs, accusing him of seeking foreign pressure against Brazil for electoral gain, which it calls treason against the homeland. The Secom statement notes Flávio was the only one among 34 Brazilian speakers not to oppose the U.S. measures and failed to disclose his ties to the Master scheme or Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: A reação do governo Lula à ida de Flávio em audiência sobre o tarifaço nos EUA
item.description: The Lula government sharply criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for attending a U.S. public hearing on the tariff against Brazilian exports, accusing him of legitimizing unfounded U.S. allegations, omitting his ties to corruption schemes linked to the Bolsonaro administration, and acting against national interests. The Secom statement claims Bolsonaro betrayed the homeland by pressuring a foreign power to sanction his own country, distinguishing legitimate opposition from treason against the nation.

item.title: Governo diz que 'divergir do governo é legítimo', mas que 'convocar uma potência' contra o Brasil é 'traição à pátria'
item.description: The federal government accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of treason for participating in a U.S. hearing on tariffs against Brazilian products and criticizing the Supreme Federal Court and the Lula administration. The Social Communication Secretariat stated that while disagreeing with the government is legitimate, inviting foreign powers to act against Brazil constitutes treason. Bolsonaro said new tariffs would be the 'worst possible timing' and would benefit Lula in an election year.

item.title: Governo Lula responde a ataques de Flávio Bolsonaro na audiência do USTR
item.description: The Lula government, through the Secretariat of Social Communication, repudiated statements made by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during a USTR hearing, calling them unacceptable. The statement was issued in response to the senator’s criticisms of Brazil’s foreign policy.

item.title: Flávio busca vacina para campanha nos EUA, mas reforça que tarifaço é político
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro traveled to the United States aiming to create a political fact that would act as a 'vaccine' against the impact of Donald Trump's tariffs on his campaign. However, his presentation to the USTR risks producing the opposite effect, potentially strengthening adverse narratives.

item.title: Nikolas sobre vídeo de Michelle: “Não tive qualquer participação”
item.description: Federal Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) denied any involvement in the production of the video where Michelle Bolsonaro claims she was disrespected by Flávio Bolsonaro, challenging anyone who can prove his participation to demand his resignation. He also dismissed speculation that he is trying to form his own parliamentary bloc to leave the PL, stating he is working to elect a legitimate, honest right-wing bloc. The statement comes amid the Bolsonaro family crisis following Michelle’s video, which sparked repercussions in June.

item.title: Brasil manterá tarifa sobre etanol dos EUA, diz Mdic
item.description: Brazil’s Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services, Márcio Elias Rosa, stated that the government does not plan to reduce import tariffs on U.S. ethanol, following President Lula’s directive that ethanol should not be addressed in isolation in bilateral trade talks, but rather alongside the issue of sugar, which faces higher tariffs in the U.S. He emphasized the need for caution regarding potential influx of U.S. ethanol, which is already affecting domestic prices, especially in the Northeast.

item.title: Brasil vê avanço com os EUA, mas mantém etanol fora da negociação
item.description: Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services Márcio Elias Rosa said Brazil has made progress in talks with the U.S. on integrated cooperation to combat transnational crime, but stressed that tariff negotiations must remain limited to that issue and not expand to other topics. He reaffirmed the government’s stance that ethanol should be excluded from trade discussions, warning that treating it in isolation ignores its link to the sugar supply chain and would harm domestic industry, especially in the Northeast, given the U.S. nearly 100% tariff on Brazilian sugar.

item.title: Senado aprova texto do ‘PIX Pensão’
item.description: The Senate approved the bill establishing 'PIX Alimony', enabling automatic transfer of child support payments via Brazil's instant payment system. Beneficiaries may request the court to direct payments to their accounts, streamlining disbursement. The proposal now awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: Direita “perdeu” ao não lançar Tarcísio, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential pre-candidate from Novo, said the right 'lost' by not launching Tarcísio de Freitas as a presidential candidate in 2026. He argued that the São Paulo governor would have been an 'extremely viable' candidate with 'no rejection'. Zema criticized the right’s failure to unite around a strong figure.
